subject: learning/parallel-memory-packet
statement: Memory merge checks no longer reject a record solely because unrelated base history has a newer ID; they apply the shared historical-transition predicate alongside all existing graph and immutability checks.
intent: Make rebases of disjoint memory work preserve record identities while retaining meaningful conflicts.
rationale: Causal relation order, record collisions, moved heads, exclusive families, and historical activation remain independent refusal boundaries. A historical violation must still be reported when another projection defect is also present.
